application_credentials.description: Create your own Netatmo app at [{developer_url}]({developer_url}) and set its redirect URI to `{redirect_url}`. Then enter the app's client ID and client secret here. Step-by-step guide: [{docs_url}]({docs_url})

reauth_confirm.title: Authentication expired
reauth_confirm.description: Netatmo no longer accepts the stored login. Sign in again to continue.

area.title: Where should we look for stations?
area.description: Pick the centre of your neighbourhood and a search radius. Public Netatmo stations inside this area will be listed next.

stations.title: Choose 1 to 3 stations
stations.description: {count} public stations found, nearest first. Pick up to three. [🗺 Open the neighbourhood on the Netatmo map]({map_url}) to compare them. You can also type station IDs (MAC addresses, comma separated) for stations that are not listed.

order.title: Set the priority

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Optionally pick an existing weather entity. Condition, forecast, UV index and other values Netatmo cannot measure are taken from it.

data.stale_minutes: Treat a station as down after (minutes without new data)

error.no_stations: No public stations found in this area. Try a larger radius.
error.duplicate_order: Each station can only be used once in the priority list.
error.invalid_id: One of the station IDs is not a valid MAC address or was not found near its position.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Netatmo. Try again later.
error.primary_missing_modules: The primary station has no wind or no rain module, so the Primary entity will lack these values while it is active. Submit again to keep this order.

abort.missing_configuration: The integration is not configured. Please add application credentials first.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, check the help section.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: OAuth authorization error while obtaining access token.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Netatmo. Try again later.

station_gone.title: Netatmo station {station} has disappeared
station_gone.description: The public station {station} has not been seen for 7 days. It was probably removed or made private. Open the integration options and pick another station.
